detail.longDescription: I wouldn't have believed it a few years ago but I'm now self hosting most things 🤯 Thanks to Coolify and Cloudflare + Claude it's just so easy 🥳 My VPS costs went up a bit 😅 But I've already said bye bye to several subscriptions 👋 Time to optimize my setup next 🚀 # SelfHosting # SelfHosted # Coolify # IndieDev # OpenSource # DevOps # FOSS # Claude # HomeLab # Docker # VPS # Cloudflare
